name: Thomas Werdmüller — a son David by Regula Steiner (bapt. 1698, Zürich)
researcher_question: Did Thomas Werdmüller of Zürich (b. 1657) have a son David baptised 27 March 1698 by a Regula Steiner, while married to Dorothea von Muralt?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 28, hint-samples.csv row 870, flag adds_spouse, confidence 3). Draft transcribed from a 1698 Zürich Reformed baptismal entry; unverified. The recorded wife was alive and married to him at the hinted date.
